context: Hand-run only, no repo scripts changed. Measure, do not trust: verify claude and codex actually honor HTTPS_PROXY. Anti-patterns: no --with-internet workarounds counted as success (that is exactly the failure mode this gate exists to prevent); no allowlist wildcards; secrets stay in env, never in the repo or in this tracker (export is public).
description: THE go/no-go gate for the whole program. The hard requirement (arbitrary agents inside the sandbox) fails with upstream single-target socat because socat raw-forwards to the local inference server and is not an HTTP proxy; cloud agents need a CONNECT proxy doing DNS on the internet side. Hand-run tinyproxy in an alpine container dual-homed on sandboxed+default. From a second sandboxed container using the EXISTING pi image (claude-code is already installed at Containerfile:66): HTTPS_PROXY=http://EGRESS_IP:8888 claude -p "say hi" must succeed while curl --max-time 5 https://google.com must fail. Repeat for codex exec with codex hand-installed. Capture every denied domain from tinyproxy logs as the seed AGENT_ALLOWLIST per agent. GATE RULE: if this cannot be made to work after honest effort, the Apple-container approach dies — record NO-GO, escalate the Lima pivot to Joe, and do not start Phase 1.

preserves.behavior: No repo script or image changes from this spike
